label: Xerox Alto (1973)
notes: Photo of the Xerox Alto, one of the first personal computers with a graphical user interface, built at Xerox PARC in 1973. Landmark machine that influenced the Macintosh.

label: Transistor Inventors (1948)
notes: Black-and-white photo of the inventors of the transistor at Bell Labs (1948) — John Bardeen, Walter Brattain, and William Shockley. One of the most important inventions of the 20th century.

label: Ilya Sutskever
notes: Ilya Sutskever seated at a panel discussion, wearing a dark blazer over a white shirt. Co-founder of OpenAI and later Safe Superintelligence Inc. Key figure in deep learning.

label: Andrej Karpathy
notes: Andrej Karpathy giving a talk at a wooden podium, wearing a pink short-sleeve button-up shirt. Former Tesla AI director and OpenAI researcher, known for educational AI content.

label: Fei-Fei Li
notes: Fei-Fei Li speaking at the ITU AI for Good summit (2017), standing at a podium with the ITU logo. Creator of ImageNet and Stanford professor — foundational figure in computer vision.

label: Elizabeth Holmes
notes: Close-up portrait of Elizabeth Holmes in her signature black turtleneck. Founder of Theranos, convicted of fraud — a cautionary tale in tech.

label: Demis Hassabis (young, chess)
notes: Black-and-white childhood photo of Demis Hassabis as a young boy playing chess at a tournament, writing notes on a scoresheet. He was a chess prodigy before co-founding DeepMind. Incredibly compelling origin story image.

label: Vitalik Buterin
notes: Vitalik Buterin on stage wearing sunglasses and a colorful cartoon-print Hawaiian shirt, holding a microphone and a small device. Classic eccentric Vitalik energy at an Ethereum event.

label: Larry Ellison
notes: Larry Ellison at the helm of a sailboat on the open ocean, wearing a dark polo shirt. Co-founder of Oracle. Great action shot capturing his adventurous side — he's famously competitive in America's Cup sailing.

label: Alexander Grothendieck
notes: Black-and-white photo of elderly Alexander Grothendieck in a hooded robe with a long white beard, holding a walking stick. One of the greatest mathematicians of the 20th century who famously became a recluse. Haunting, monk-like image.

label: Watson & Crick – DNA Double Helix
notes: Iconic black-and-white photo of James Watson and Francis Crick with their DNA double helix model at the Cavendish Laboratory. One of the most famous scientific images of the 20th century.

label: Ted Kaczynski (young)
notes: Young Ted Kaczynski standing outdoors in a forest near a car with its hood up. Former UC Berkeley math professor turned anti-technology extremist. Provocative inclusion for a techno-optimism gallery.

label: Julian Assange (young)
notes: Young Julian Assange walking down courthouse steps in a navy suit with sunglasses and a patterned tie. WikiLeaks founder — early hacker era photo, before international fame.

label: Alexandr Wang
notes: Alexandr Wang walking on a red carpet in a navy suit and tie at what appears to be a formal evening event. Co-founder of Scale AI, became the youngest self-made billionaire.

label: Mark Zuckerberg (early Facebook era)
notes: Young Mark Zuckerberg sitting cross-legged on the floor of an early Facebook office, wearing Adidas slides, jeans, and a dark hoodie. Iconic early startup culture image — raw and authentic.

label: Alan Turing (running)
notes: Alan Turing running in a race, wearing bib number 140, with spectators watching. Father of computer science and WWII codebreaker — also an accomplished distance runner. Rare and humanizing photo.

label: Luke Farritor
notes: Luke Farritor on Fox News (Jesse Watters Primetime), wearing a suit and glasses. DOGE member and Vesuvius Challenge winner who used ML to read ancient scrolls. Chyron reads 'Musk thanks good government workers'.

label: Pavel Durov
notes: Pavel Durov in a dramatic styled photoshoot — shirtless in a white toga-like drape, seated on hay bales with a goat. Founder of Telegram and VK. Highly unconventional and memorable portrait.

label: Cyan Banister
notes: Cyan Banister seated in a chair in a cozy study/office with bookshelves, wearing a black floral-embroidered dress, cowboy boots, and a black hat. Legendary angel investor — early backer of SpaceX, Uber, and others.

label: Masayoshi Son
notes: Masayoshi Son wearing sunglasses and a black turtleneck suit, holding up a flip phone at a product launch event with models behind him. Founder of SoftBank and Vision Fund — bold, Steve Jobs-esque energy.

label: Richard Stallman
notes: Richard Stallman lounging across red auditorium seats, wearing a batik-print shirt. Founder of the GNU project and Free Software Foundation — icon of the open-source movement. Classic irreverent RMS pose.

label: Ross Ulbricht
notes: Ross Ulbricht walking through a parking lot at night in grey sweats, smiling and carrying a small potted plant. Founder of Silk Road — recently pardoned. Casual, humanizing post-release photo.
